verdict.rationale: Instinct is documented as an autonomous personal assistant you delegate to by text or call. Hands-on reviewers describe multi-step tasks it carried out on its own and reported back in the same chat: placing phone calls to book restaurants and dentist waitlists, and handling podcast booking follow-ups while pinging the user only when needed. The 'return for my review' half is weaker: no documented approval or checkpoint mechanism appears, and testers report it sent an email without checking first and made an unwanted reservation with a $200 fee. missing for 10: documented review/approval-before-action flow, task status or progress visibility, first-party docs describing background task handling, reliable check-ins before consequential actions.
